tools.name: search_gear
tools.description: Search camera, lens, lighting, sound and other production gear for hire. Optional filters: category (a slug from list_categories), city (a South African city), and start_date/end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) to keep only items free on those dates. Returns prices in ZAR per day and the page URL to book.

tools.name: get_gear
tools.description: Full details of one rental item by its id or slug (from search_gear): price per day in ZAR, deposit, what comes with it, and the page URL to book.

tools.name: search_creators
tools.description: Search ID-checked photographers, videographers and other creators open for bookings. Optional filters: category (a studio category slug from list_categories, or a specialisation like Photography) and city. Returns hourly rates in ZAR and the profile URL to book.

tools.name: get_creator
tools.description: A creator profile by handle (from search_creators): what they do, where they are based, their rate in ZAR and the profile URL to book.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The gear categories that have stock (with item counts) and the studio categories for shoots (with creator counts).

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Ubunye Apps: free, open source apps for photo and film, with download links, the browser version and the source code.

tools.name: how_to_book
tools.description: How to rent gear or book a creator: the steps, notice needed, deposit, ID check, collection and delivery, cancelling, and how to pay. Booking itself happens on the website.
